answer: The tide register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and bridge seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 73 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 73 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 244 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
